config.grain_rationale: One record is one current Victorian liquor licence (one licence number) held at one premises. The business participant is the licensee; its legal name, trading name and premises address are mapped as attributes of the licence holder, not of the licence itself. Licence Number is the licence's own ID, so it is not used as a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: Licence Number is present on 100% of rows and has 465 distinct values in 465 discovery records, so it is unique per record and traceable.

fields.rationale: Column headed 'Licensee' - a licence is issued to a legal person, so this is the registered legal name of the holder. Values look like registered entity names (ALDI FOODS PTY LIMITED, ENDEAVOUR GROUP LIMITED, CITY OF DAREBIN), with some sole traders (WOOD GERARD). Placeholder nulls added defensively; none were observed here.

Explicitly a trading-as/business name column, distinct from the licensee (ALDI FOODS PTY LIMITED -> ALDI STORES). Held-out records contained a bare '.' placeholder, which is nulled rather than emitted.
Street address of the licensed premises (not the postal address), paired with Suburb/Postcode columns. Held-out records contained a bare '-' placeholder, which is nulled rather than emitted.

Locality of the premises address row. The discovery profile showed 7 rows shaped '[a a] -' i.e. '[NOT APPLICABLE] -' markers (case varies in the source: '[Not applicable] -'); these are placeholders for licences with no fixed premises locality and are nulled.
4-digit premises postcode. A handful of rows contain '0' (7 of 465) which is a placeholder, not a postcode, so it is nulled.

constants.rationale: Victorian liquor licence register published by Liquor Control Victoria; every premises is in Victoria.

unmapped.reason: The licence's own identifier, not a business identifier. Used only for record_id.
Status/type of the licence, not the legal entity's business form; entity_type enum does not permit licence categories and guessing would be wrong.
Licence condition, not an entity attribute.
Local government area of the premises; no ontology target (address.state is a state enum, not an LGA).
Licensing region label; no ontology target.
Geographic classifier for the licence area; no ontology target.
Postal address of the licensee, not the premises address; mapping it too would conflict with the premises address claimed by address.full.
Part of the postal (correspondence) address, not the premises locality.
Part of the postal (correspondence) address, not the premises postcode; also contains interstate postcodes (e.g. 2000 NSW).

config.notes: Single sheet 'Current_Victorian_Licences_By_L'; rows 1-3 are publisher contact block, a title ('Current Victorian Liquor Licences as of 31/08/2026') and a blank line, so header is row 5 -> skip_rows 4. No ABN/ACN columns exist, so none are mapped (Licence Number is 8 digits and fails both checksums - it is not an ACN). The snapshot date 31/08/2026 appears only in the title text, not as a per-record column, so observed_at falls back to resource_last_modified. Status of the licence is not mapped to entity.status: the sheet lists current licences, which says nothing about the entity's registered status. Revision: null_if placeholder lists were widened on entity.legal_name, entity.trading_name, address.full, address.locality and address.postcode after held-out records emitted '.', '-', and '[NOT APPLICABLE] -' markers.
